 912: def require_verified():
 913:     """
 914:     Check if user is logged in AND their email is verified AND not suspended.
 915:     Returns a redirect if not, otherwise None.
 916:     """
 917:     if not session.get("user_id"):
 918:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
 919:     
 920:     user_id = session["user_id"]
 921:     
 922:     # Check if suspended
 923:     if is_user_suspended(user_id):
 924:         session.clear()
 925:         flash("❌ Your account has been suspended. Please contact support for assistance.", "error")
 926:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
 927:     
 928:     if not is_email_verified(user_id):
 929:         # User is logged in but not verified - redirect to verification page
 930:         flash("⚠️ Please verify your email address to access all features.", "warning")
 931:         return redirect(url_for("request_verification"))
 932:     
 933:     return None
 934: 
 935: def verify_flutterwave_webhook(data, signature):
 936:     """Verify webhook signature.
 937: 
 938:     Flutterwave's verif-hash header is NOT an HMAC of the payload —
 939:     it's the secret hash you configured in the dashboard, echoed back
 940:     verbatim. Verification is a plain constant-time string comparison.
 941:     """
 942:     webhook_secret = os.environ.get("FLW_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")
 943: 
 944:     if not webhook_secret:
 945:         print("❌ FLW_WEBHOOK_SECRET not set - rejecting webhook (fail closed)")
 946:         return False
 947: 
 948:     if not signature:
 949:         print("❌ No signature provided")
 950:         return False
 951: 
 952:     return hmac.compare_digest(webhook_secret, signature)
 953:

1271: # =============================================================================
1272: # ERROR HANDLERS
1273: # =============================================================================
1274: @app.errorhandler(401)
1275: def unauthorized(e):
1276:     """Unauthorized - user isn't logged in but tried to access a protected page."""
1277:     # This will usually be caught by your require_login() redirect first,
1278:     # but just in case Flask's auth machinery triggers it:
1279:     return redirect(url_for('login'))
1280: 
1281: @app.errorhandler(404)
1282: def page_not_found(e):
1283:     """Page not found - user followed a broken link or typed a wrong URL."""
1284:     return render_template('errors/404.html'), 404
1285: 
1286: 
1287: @app.errorhandler(500)
1288: def internal_server_error(e):
1289:     """Internal server error - something unexpected broke in the app."""
1290:     return render_template('errors/500.html'), 500
1291: 
1292: 
1293: @app.errorhandler(403)
1294: def forbidden(e):
1295:     """Forbidden - user tried to access something they shouldn't."""
1296:     return render_template('errors/403.html'), 403
1297: 
1298: 
1299: @app.errorhandler(405)
1300: def method_not_allowed(e):
1301:     """Method not allowed - e.g., GET instead of POST."""
1302:     return render_template('errors/405.html'), 405
1303: 
1304: @app.errorhandler(429)
1305: def ratelimit_handler(e):
1306:     """Return a user-friendly message when rate limit is exceeded."""
1307:     # e.description contains the custom error message
1308:     error_message = e.description if e.description else "Too many requests. Please slow down."
1309:     return render_template('errors/429.html', error_message=error_message), 429
1310: 
1311: # =============================================================================
1312: # ROUTES - PUBLIC
1313: # =============================================================================
1314: @app.route("/")
1315: @limiter.exempt
1316: def home():
1317:     """Show landing page for non-logged-in users, dashboard for logged-in users."""
1318:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1319:         region = get_user_region()
1320:         pricing = get_pricing(region)
1321:         return render_template("landing.html", pricing=pricing)
1322: 
1323:     user_id = session["user_id"]
1324:     
1325:     # Check if suspended FIRST
1326:     if is_user_suspended(user_id):
1327:         session.clear()
1328:         flash("❌ Your account has been suspended. Please contact support.", "error")
1329:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
1330:     
1331:     # Get subscription status
1332:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
1333:     tier = sub_status['tier']
1334:     status = sub_status['status']
1335:     is_active = sub_status['is_active']
1336:     documents_trimmed = sub_status.get('documents_trimmed', False)
1337: 
1338:     # Check if trial has expired (for both Pro and VIP)
1339:     if tier in ['pro', 'vip'] and status == 'active' and sub_status.get('trial_used', False):
1340:         trial_ends_at = sub_status.get('trial_ends_at')
1341:         if trial_ends_at and trial_ends_at <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
1342:             # Trial expired - downgrade to free
1343:             conn = get_db()
1344:             try:
1345:                 cursor = conn.cursor()
1346:                 # Trim documents if over limit
1347:                 trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1348:                 cursor.execute("""
1349:                     UPDATE users 
1350:                     SET subscription_tier = 'free',
1351:                         subscription_status = 'expired',
1352:                         subscription_expiry = NULL,
1353:                         trial_ends_at = NULL
1354:                     WHERE id = %s
1355:                 """, (user_id,))
1356:                 conn.commit()
1357:                 cursor.close()
1358:                 flash("⚠️ Your free trial has ended. Upgrade to continue using Pro features.", "warning")
1359:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
1360:             except Exception as e:
1361:                 print(f"❌ Error ending trial: {e}")
1362:                 flash("An error occurred. Please contact support.", "error")
1363:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
1364:             finally:
1365:                 put_db(conn)
1366:     
1367:     # REMOVE GRACE PERIOD CODE - Just handle expired subscriptions directly
1368:     if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not is_active:
1369:         # Subscription expired - downgrade immediately
1370:         deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1371:         
1372:         conn = get_db()
1373:         try:
1374:             cursor = conn.cursor()
1375:             cursor.execute("""
1376:                 UPDATE users 
1377:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
1378:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
1379:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
1380:                     documents_trimmed = TRUE
1381:                 WHERE id = %s
1382:             """, (user_id,))
1383:             conn.commit()
1384:             cursor.close()
1385:         finally:
1386:             put_db(conn)
1387:         
1388:         if deleted_count > 0:
1389:             flash(
1390:                 f"⚠️ Your subscription has expired. We've kept your 20 most important documents "
1391:                 f"(farthest from expiry) and removed {deleted_count} documents. "
1392:                 f"Upgrade to Pro or VIP to track more than 20 documents.",
1393:                 "warning"
1394:             )
1395:         else:
1396:             flash("⚠️ Your subscription has expired. You're now on the Free plan.", "warning")
1397:         
1398:         # Refresh subscription status
1399:         sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
1400:         tier = sub_status['tier']
1401:         status = sub_status['status']
1402:         documents_trimmed = True
1403:     
1404:     # Get document count
1405:     doc_count = get_document_count(user_id)
1406:     
1407:     # If on free plan and over limit (shouldn't happen after trim, but just in case)
1408:     if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
1409:         deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1410:         if deleted_count > 0:
1411:             flash(
1412:                 f"⚠️ You have more than 20 documents on the Free plan. "
1413:                 f"We've kept your 20 most important documents (farthest from expiry) "
1414:                 f"and removed {deleted_count} documents. "
1415:                 f"Upgrade to Pro or VIP to track more than 20 documents.",
1416:                 "warning"
1417:             )
1418:             doc_count = get_document_count(user_id)
1419:     
1420:     search_query = request.args.get("q", "").strip()
1421:     status_filter = request.args.get("status", "")
1422: 
1423:     docs = get_documents(user_id, search_query)
1424:     documents = []
1425: 
1426:     for doc_id, title, expiry_date in docs:
1427:         days_left, doc_status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
1428: 
1429:         if status_filter and doc_status != status_filter:
1430:             continue
1431: 
1432:         if days_left < 0:
1433:             display_days = f"{abs(days_left)} days overdue"
1434:         else:
1435:             display_days = f"{days_left} days left"
1436: 
1437:         documents.append({
1438:             "id": doc_id,
1439:             "title": title,
1440:             "expiry_date": expiry_date,
1441:             "display_days": display_days,
1442:             "status": doc_status,
1443:             "color": color,
1444:             "icon": icon
1445:         })
1446: 
1447:     # ALWAYS return here at the end
1448:     return render_template(
1449:         "index.html", 
1450:         documents=documents, 
1451:         doc_count=doc_count,  
1452:         subscription_tier=tier,
1453:         subscription_status=status,
1454:         subscription_expiry=sub_status.get('expiry'),
1455:         on_trial=sub_status.get('on_trial', False),
1456:         trial_ends_at=sub_status.get('trial_ends_at'),
1457:         now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1458:     )
1459:

1470: @app.route("/contact", methods=["GET", "POST"])
1471: @limiter.limit("10 per hour", error_message="Too many contact form submissions. Please try again later.")
1472: def contact():
1473:     """Contact page for support and business inquiries. Also handles
1474:     feedback submissions (routed here from /feedback so they share one
1475:     inquiries table and one notification/auto-reply pipeline)."""
1476:     error = None
1477:     success = None
1478: 
1479:     if request.method == "POST":
1480:         name = request.form.get("name", "").strip()
1481:         email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
1482:         subject = request.form.get("subject", "").strip()
1483:         message = request.form.get("message", "").strip()
1484:         inquiry_type = request.form.get("inquiry_type", "support")
1485:         is_feedback = inquiry_type == "feedback"
1486: 
1487:         # Validation
1488:         if not name:
1489:             error = "Please enter your name."
1490:         elif not email:
1491:             error = "Please enter your email address."
1492:         else:
1493:             try:
1494:                 validate_email(email)
1495:             except EmailNotValidError:
1496:                 error = "Please enter a valid email address."
1497: 
1498:         if not error and not subject:
1499:             error = "Please enter a subject."
1500:         elif not error and (not message or len(message) < 10):
1501:             error = "Please enter a message (at least 10 characters)."
1502: 
1503:         if not error:
1504:             try:
1505:                 # Store in database
1506:                 conn = get_db()
1507:                 try:
1508:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
1509:                     cursor.execute("""
1510:                         INSERT INTO contact_inquiries 
1511:                         (name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, created_at)
1512:                         VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1513:                         RETURNING id
1514:                     """, (name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, datetime.now(timezone.utc)))
1515:                     inquiry_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1516:                     conn.commit()
1517:                     cursor.close()
1518:                 finally:
1519:                     put_db(conn)
1520: 
1521:                 # Send notification to you (support@fritt.org or your personal email)
1522:                 send_inquiry_notification(name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, inquiry_id)
1523: 
1524:                 # Send auto-reply to user
1525:                 send_auto_reply(email, name, inquiry_type)
1526: 
1527:                 if is_feedback:
1528:                     flash("✅ Thanks for your feedback! We read every submission.", "success")
1529:                     return redirect(url_for("home"))
1530: 
1531:                 success = "✅ Your message has been sent! We'll get back to you within 24 hours."
1532: 
1533:             except Exception as e:
1534:                 print(f"❌ Error saving inquiry: {e}")
1535:                 error = "Something went wrong. Please try again later."
1536: 
1537:         # Validation failed, or the try block above raised before returning
1538:         if error and is_feedback:
1539:             return render_template("feedback.html", error=error)
1540: 
1541:     return render_template("contact.html", error=error, success=success)
1542:

1605: def send_inquiry_notification(name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, inquiry_id):
1606:     """Send notification to you (the admin)."""
1607:     if not RESEND_API_KEY:
1608:         print(f"📧 New {inquiry_type} inquiry from {name} ({email}): {subject}")
1609:         return
1610:     
1611:     try:
1612:         # Send to your personal email (or support@fritt.org later)
1613:         if not ADMIN_EMAIL:
1614:             print(f"⚠️ WARNING: ADMIN_EMAIL not set. Inquiry from {email} was not sent.")
1615:             return
1616:         
1617:         response = requests.post(
1618:             "https://api.resend.com/emails",
1619:             headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RESEND_API_KEY}"},
1620:             json={
1621:                 "from": RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
1622:                 "to": [ADMIN_EMAIL],
1623:                 "reply_to": [email],
1624:                 "subject": f"[Fritt Tracker] New {inquiry_type} inquiry: {subject}",
1625:                 "html": f"""
1626:                     <h2>New {inquiry_type.capitalize()} Inquiry</h2>
1627:                     <p><strong>From:</strong> {name} ({email})</p>
1628:                     <p><strong>Subject:</strong> {subject}</p>
1629:                     <p><strong>Message:</strong></p>
1630:                     <p>{message.replace(chr(10), '<br>')}</p>
1631:                     <hr>
1632:                     <p><strong>Inquiry ID:</strong> #{inquiry_id}</p>
1633:                     <p><strong>Type:</strong> {inquiry_type}</p>
1634:                     <p>Reply directly to this email to respond to {name}.</p>
1635:                 """,
1636:                 "text": f"""
1637:                     New {inquiry_type} Inquiry
1638:                     
1639:                     From: {name} ({email})
1640:                     Subject: {subject}
1641:                     
1642:                     Message:
1643:                     {message}
1644:                     
1645:                     Inquiry ID: #{inquiry_id}
1646:                     Type: {inquiry_type}
1647:                 """
1648:             },
1649:             timeout=10
1650:         )
1651:         if response.status_code >= 400:
1652:             print(f"⚠️ Failed to send inquiry notification: {response.text}")
1653:     except Exception as e:
1654:         print(f"⚠️ Error sending inquiry notification: {e}")

1824: # =============================================================================

1827: 
1828: def require_admin():
1829:     """Decorator-like function to require admin access."""
1830:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1831:         flash("Please log in to access the admin area.", "warning")
1832:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
1833:     
1834:     if not is_admin():
1835:         flash("You don't have permission to access the admin area.", "error")
1836:         abort(403)
1837:     
1838:     return None
1839: 
1840: 
1841: def log_admin_action(action, target_type=None, target_id=None, details=None):
1842:     """Log admin actions for audit trail."""
1843:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1844:         return
1845:     
1846:     conn = get_db()
1847:     try:
1848:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1849:         cursor.execute("""
1850:             INSERT INTO audit_log 
1851:             (admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, details, ip_address, user_agent)
1852:             VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1853:         """, (
1854:             session["user_id"],
1855:             action,
1856:             target_type,
1857:             target_id,
1858:             json.dumps(details) if details else None,
1859:             request.remote_addr,
1860:             request.headers.get('User-Agent')
1861:         ))
1862:         conn.commit()
1863:         cursor.close()
1864:     finally:
1865:         put_db(conn)
1866: 
1867: 
1868: @app.route("/admin")
1869: def admin_dashboard():
1870:     """Admin dashboard - overview of everything."""
1871:     auth = require_admin()
1872:     if auth:
1873:         return auth
1874:     
1875:     conn = get_db()
1876:     try:
1877:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1878:         
1879:         # Get stats
1880:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users")
1881:         total_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1882:         
1883:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email_verified = TRUE")
1884:         verified_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1885:         
1886:         cursor.execute("""
1887:             SELECT subscription_tier, COUNT(*) 
1888:             FROM users 
1889:             GROUP BY subscription_tier
1890:         """)
1891:         subscription_stats = cursor.fetchall()
1892:         
1893:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents")
1894:         total_documents = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1895:         
1896:         cursor.execute("""
1897:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents 
1898:             WHERE expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE
1899:         """)
1900:         expired_documents = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1901:         
1902:         cursor.execute("""
1903:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents 
1904:             WHERE expiry_date::date > CURRENT_DATE 
1905:             AND expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '14 days'
1906:         """)
1907:         expiring_soon = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1908:         
1909:         cursor.execute("""
1910:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flagged_users WHERE status = 'pending'
1911:         """)
1912:         pending_flags = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1913:         
1914:         cursor.execute("""
1915:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_inquiries WHERE status = 'new'
1916:         """)
1917:         pending_inquiries = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1918:         
1919:         cursor.execute("""
1920:             SELECT id, email, subscription_tier, email_verified, created_at,
1921:                    trial_used, trial_ends_at,
1922:                    subscription_status, subscription_expiry
1923:             FROM users
1924:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
1925:             LIMIT 10
1926:         """)
1927:         raw_recent_users = cursor.fetchall()
1928: 
1929:         cursor.execute("""
1930:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users
1931:             WHERE trial_used = TRUE
1932:             AND trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL
1933:             AND trial_ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
1934:             AND subscription_status = 'active'
1935:         """)
1936:         trial_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1937:         
1938:         cursor.close()
1939:         
1940:     finally:
1941:         put_db(conn)
1942: 
1943:     # Enrich recent_users with display info.
1944:     # Raw layout (indices 0..8):
1945:     #   [0]=id, [1]=email, [2]=tier, [3]=verified, [4]=created_at,
1946:     #   [5]=trial_used, [6]=trial_ends_at, [7]=subscription_status,
1947:     #   [8]=subscription_expiry
1948:     # Enriched: [9]=display_label, [10]=is_trial, [11]=is_trial_expired, [12]=is_expired
1949:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1950:     recent_users = []
1951:     for row in raw_recent_users:
1952:         row = list(row)
1953:         label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired = compute_display_plan(
1954:             tier=row[2],
1955:             status=row[7],
1956:             trial_used=row[5],
1957:             trial_ends_at=row[6],
1958:             subscription_expiry=row[8],
1959:             now=now,
1960:         )
1961:         row.extend([label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired])
1962:         recent_users.append(tuple(row))
1963:     
1964:     return render_template(
1965:         "admin/dashboard.html",
1966:         total_users=total_users,
1967:         verified_users=verified_users,
1968:         subscription_stats=subscription_stats,
1969:         total_documents=total_documents,
1970:         expired_documents=expired_documents,
1971:         expiring_soon=expiring_soon,
1972:         pending_flags=pending_flags,

1976:         now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)

1980: @app.route("/admin/users")
1981: def admin_users():
1982:     """View and manage all users."""
1983:     auth = require_admin()
1984:     if auth:
1985:         return auth
1986: 
1987:     search = request.args.get("search", "")
1988:     status = request.args.get("status", "all")
1989:     page = int(request.args.get("page", 1))
1990:     per_page = 20
1991:     offset = (page - 1) * per_page
1992: 
1993:     conn = get_db()
1994:     try:
1995:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1996: 
1997:         # Build query
1998:         query = """
1999:             SELECT u.id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.subscription_tier,
2000:                 u.subscription_status, u.created_at,
2001:                 COUNT(d.id) as doc_count,
2002:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) as is_admin,
2003:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending') as is_flagged,
2004:                 u.trial_used,
2005:                 u.trial_ends_at,
2006:                 u.suspended
2007:             FROM users u
2008:             LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.user_id = u.id
2009:         """
2010:         where_clauses = []
2011:         params = []
2012: 
2013:         if search:
2014:             where_clauses.append("u.email ILIKE %s")
2015:             params.append(f"%{search}%")
2016: 
2017:         if status == "verified":
2018:             where_clauses.append("u.email_verified = TRUE")
2019:         elif status == "unverified":
2020:             where_clauses.append("u.email_verified = FALSE")
2021:         elif status == "flagged":
2022:             where_clauses.append(
2023:                 "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending')"
2024:             )
2025:         elif status == "admin":
2026:             where_clauses.append(
2027:                 "EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id)"
2028:             )
2029: 
2030:         if where_clauses:
2031:             query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where_clauses)
2032: 
2033:         query += " GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT %s OFFSET %s"
2034:         params.extend([per_page, offset])
2035: 
2036:         cursor.execute(query, params)
2037:         raw_users = cursor.fetchall()
2038: 
2039:         # Get total count for pagination
2040:         count_query = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u"
2041:         if where_clauses:
2042:             count_query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where_clauses)
2043:         cursor.execute(count_query, params[:-2])  # Exclude LIMIT/OFFSET
2044:         total_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2045: 
2046:         cursor.close()
2047: 
2048:     finally:
2049:         put_db(conn)
2050: 
2051:     # Enrich each row with computed display info.
2052:     # Raw row layout (indices 0..10):
2053:     #   [0]=id, [1]=email, [2]=verified, [3]=tier, [4]=sub_status,
2054:     #   [5]=created_at, [6]=doc_count, [7]=is_admin, [8]=is_flagged,
2055:     #   [9]=trial_used, [10]=trial_ends_at
2056:     # Enriched row appends:
2057:     #   [11]=display_label, [12]=is_trial, [13]=is_trial_expired, [14]=is_expired
2058:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
2059:     users = []
2060:     for row in raw_users:
2061:         row = list(row)
2062:         label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired = compute_display_plan(
2063:             tier=row[3],
2064:             status=row[4],
2065:             trial_used=row[9],
2066:             trial_ends_at=row[10],
2067:             subscription_expiry=None,  # not selected here; not needed by this view
2068:             now=now,
2069:             suspended=row[11]
2070:         )
2071:         row.extend([label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired])
2072:         users.append(tuple(row))
2073: 
2074:     return render_template(
2075:         "admin/users.html",
2076:         users=users,
2077:         total_users=total_users,
2078:         page=page,
2079:         per_page=per_page,
2080:         search=search,
2081:         status=status,
2082:         now=now,
2083:     )

2085: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>")
2086: def admin_user_detail(user_id):
2087:     """View detailed user information."""
2088:     auth = require_admin()
2089:     if auth:
2090:         return auth
2091: 
2092:     conn = get_db()
2093:     try:
2094:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2095: 
2096:         cursor.execute("""
2097:             SELECT u.id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.subscription_tier,
2098:                 u.subscription_status, u.subscription_expiry, u.created_at,
2099:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) as is_admin,
2100:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending') as is_flagged,
2101:                 u.trial_used,
2102:                 u.trial_ends_at,
2103:                 u.suspended
2104:             FROM users u
2105:             WHERE u.id = %s
2106:         """, (user_id,))
2107:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2108: 
2109:         if not user:
2110:             abort(404)
2111: 
2112:         # Convert expiry to timezone-aware if needed
2113:         if user[5] and user[5].tzinfo is None:
2114:             user = list(user)
2115:             user[5] = user[5].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
2116:             user = tuple(user)
2117: 
2118:         # Get user documents - just get the raw data
2119:         cursor.execute("""
2120:             SELECT id, title, expiry_date
2121:             FROM documents
2122:             WHERE user_id = %s
2123:             ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
2124:         """, (user_id,))
2125:         raw_documents = cursor.fetchall()
2126: 
2127:         documents = []
2128:         for doc_id, title, expiry_date in raw_documents:
2129:             days_left, status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
2130:             documents.append({
2131:                 'id': doc_id,
2132:                 'title': title,
2133:                 'expiry_date': expiry_date,
2134:                 'days_left': days_left,
2135:                 'status': status,
2136:                 'color': color,
2137:                 'icon': icon,
2138:             })
2139: 
2140:         # Get user activity logs
2141:         cursor.execute("""
2142:             SELECT action, details, created_at
2143:             FROM user_activity_logs
2144:             WHERE user_id = %s
2145:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
2146:             LIMIT 50
2147:         """, (user_id,))
2148:         activity_logs = cursor.fetchall()
2149: 
2150:         # Get audit logs for this user
2151:         cursor.execute("""
2152:             SELECT action, target_type, details, created_at
2153:             FROM audit_log
2154:             WHERE target_type = 'user' AND target_id = %s
2155:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
2156:             LIMIT 20
2157:         """, (user_id,))
2158:         audit_logs = cursor.fetchall()
2159: 
2160:         cursor.close()
2161: 
2162:     finally:
2163:         put_db(conn)
2164: 
2165:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
2166: 
2167:     # Enrich user row with computed display info.
2168:     # Raw layout: [0..10] same as above
2169:     # Appended:   [11]=display_label, [12]=is_trial, [13]=is_trial_expired, [14]=is_expired
2170:     user = list(user)
2171:     label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired = compute_display_plan(
2172:         tier=user[3],
2173:         status=user[4],
2174:         trial_used=user[9],
2175:         trial_ends_at=user[10],
2176:         subscription_expiry=user[5],
2177:         now=now,
2178:         suspended=user[11]
2179:     )
2180:     user.extend([label, is_trial, is_trial_expired, is_expired])
2181:     user = tuple(user)
2182: 
2183:     return render_template(
2184:         "admin/user_detail.html",
2185:         user=user,
2186:         documents=documents,
2187:         activity_logs=activity_logs,
2188:         audit_logs=audit_logs,
2189:         now=now,

2192: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/action", methods=["POST"])

2194:     """Perform actions on a user (suspend, verify, make admin, etc.)."""
2195:     auth = require_admin()
2196:     if auth:
2197:         return auth

2207:         cursor = conn.cursor()

2212:                 (user_id,)

2220:                 "INSERT INTO admin_users (user_id) VALUES (%s) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING",
2221:                 (user_id,)
2222:             )
2223:             conn.commit()
2224:             log_admin_action("make_admin", "user", user_id, {"action": "made_admin"})
2225:             flash("✅ User is now an admin.", "success")

2234:             flash("✅ Admin privileges removed.", "success")

2278:                 "SELECT subscription_tier, subscription_status, subscription_expiry FROM users WHERE id = %s AND suspended = TRUE",

2289:                     if current_status in ['active', 'cancelled'] and current_expiry and current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
2290:                         has_valid_subscription = True

2604: @app.route("/admin/documents")
2605: def admin_documents():
2606:     """View all documents across all users, grouped by user."""
2607:     auth = require_admin()
2608:     if auth:
2609:         return auth
2610:     
2611:     conn = get_db()
2612:     try:
2613:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2614:         cursor.execute("""
2615:             SELECT d.id, d.title, d.expiry_date, d.user_id, u.email
2616:             FROM documents d
2617:             JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
2618:             ORDER BY u.email ASC, d.expiry_date ASC
2619:             LIMIT 100
2620:         """)
2621:         raw_documents = cursor.fetchall()
2622:         cursor.close()
2623:         
2624:         # Process documents through get_status() for consistency
2625:         documents = []
2626:         for doc_id, title, expiry_date, user_id, email in raw_documents:
2627:             days_left, status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
2628:             documents.append({
2629:                 'id': doc_id,
2630:                 'title': title,
2631:                 'expiry_date': expiry_date,
2632:                 'user_id': user_id,
2633:                 'email': email,
2634:                 'days_left': days_left,
2635:                 'status': status,
2636:                 'color': color,
2637:                 'icon': icon
2638:             })
2639:         
2640:     finally:
2641:         put_db(conn)
2642:     
2643:     return render_template("admin/documents.html", documents=documents)

2669: @app.route("/admin/fix-user/<int:user_id>")
2670: def admin_fix_user(user_id):
2671:     """Force a subscription check and cleanup for a user."""
2672:     auth = require_admin()
2673:     if auth:
2674:         return auth
2675:     
2676:     # Check if user exists
2677:     conn = get_db()
2678:     try:
2679:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2680:         cursor.execute("SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2681:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2682:         if not user:
2683:             flash("User not found.", "error")
2684:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2685:         
2686:         # Force subscription check
2687:         sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
2688:         tier = sub_status['tier']
2689:         
2690:         if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not sub_status['is_active']:
2691:             deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2692:             cursor.execute("""
2693:                 UPDATE users 
2694:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free', 
2695:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
2696:                     subscription_expiry = NULL
2697:                 WHERE id = %s
2698:             """, (user_id,))
2699:             conn.commit()
2700:             flash(f"✅ User {user[0]} downgraded to Free. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "success")
2701:         else:
2702:             # Just check and trim if over limit
2703:             cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2704:             doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2705:             if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
2706:                 deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2707:                 flash(f"⚠️ User had {doc_count} documents on Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "warning")
2708:             else:
2709:                 flash(f"✅ User {user[0]} is on {tier} plan with {doc_count} documents. No changes needed.", "success")
2710:         
2711:         cursor.close()
2712:     finally:
2713:         put_db(conn)
2714:     
2715:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))

2786:     """Delete a document on behalf of a user."""

2789:         return auth

2792:     try:
2793:         cursor = conn.cursor()

2796:         cursor.execute(
2797:             "SELECT title FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2798:             (doc_id, user_id)
2799:         )
2800:         doc = cursor.fetchone()

2802:             flash("Document not found or doesn't belong to this user.", "error")

2824: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/document/<int:doc_id>/renew", methods=["GET", "POST"])
2825: def admin_renew_user_document(user_id, doc_id):
2826:     """Renew a document on behalf of a user."""
2827:     auth = require_admin()
2828:     if auth:
2829:         return auth
2830:     
2831:     conn = get_db()
2832:     try:
2833:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2834:         
2835:         # Get document info
2836:         cursor.execute(
2837:             "SELECT title, expiry_date FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2838:             (doc_id, user_id)
2839:         )
2840:         doc = cursor.fetchone()
2841:         if not doc:
2842:             flash("Document not found or doesn't belong to this user.", "error")
2843:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2844:         
2845:         if request.method == "POST":
2846:             new_expiry = request.form.get("expiry_date")
2847:             
2848:             if not new_expiry:
2849:                 flash("Please select a new expiry date.", "error")
2850:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_renew_user_document", user_id=user_id, doc_id=doc_id))
2851:             
2852:             try:
2853:                 datetime.strptime(new_expiry, "%Y-%m-%d")
2854:             except ValueError:
2855:                 flash("Invalid date format.", "error")
2856:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_renew_user_document", user_id=user_id, doc_id=doc_id))
2857:             
2858:             cursor.execute("""
2859:                 UPDATE documents 
2860:                 SET expiry_date = %s, 
2861:                     last_reminder_sent = NULL, 
2862:                     reminder_state = NULL, 
2863:                     snoozed_until = NULL 
2864:                 WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s
2865:             """, (new_expiry, doc_id, user_id))
2866:             conn.commit()
2867:             
2868:             log_admin_action("admin_renew_document", "document", doc_id, {"user_id": user_id, "new_expiry": new_expiry})
2869:             flash(f"✅ Document '{doc[0]}' renewed successfully to {new_expiry}.", "success")
2870:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2871:         
2872:         cursor.close()
2873:         
2874:     finally:
2875:         put_db(conn)
2876:     
2877:     return render_template(
2878:         "admin/renew_documents.html",
2879:         user_id=user_id,
2880:         doc_id=doc_id,
2881:         doc=doc
2882:     )

2900:

2902:     if ALLOWED_TEST_EMAIL:

2904:             flash(f"Only the configured test account can be reset.", "error")
2905:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))

2907:         if email != 'test@fritt.org':
2908:             flash("Only test accounts can be reset. Set TEST_EMAIL env variable to configure.", "error")
2909:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))

2913:         cursor = conn.cursor()

3043: @app.route("/register", methods=["GET", "POST"])
3044: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many registration attempts. Please try again later.")
3045: def register():
3046:     """User registration."""
3047:     error = None
3048:     if request.method == "POST":
3049:         email = request.form["email"].strip().lower()
3050:         password = request.form["password"]
3051: 
3052:         password_errors = validate_password_strength(password)
3053:         if password_errors:
3054:             error = f"Password must contain: {', '.join(password_errors)}"
3055:         else:
3056:             conn = get_db()
3057:             try:
3058:                 cursor = conn.cursor()
3059:                 cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = %s", (email,))
3060:                 if cursor.fetchone():
3061:                     error = "An account with that email already exists"
3062:                 else:
3063:                     password_hash = generate_password_hash(password)
3064:                     cursor.execute(
3065:                         "INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, email_verified) VALUES (%s, %s, %s) RETURNING id",
3066:                         (email, password_hash, False)
3067:                     )
3068:                     new_user_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
3069:                     conn.commit()
3070: 
3071:                     # Send verification email
3072:                     send_verification_email(email, new_user_id)
3073:                     
3074:                     # ⭐ LOG THE USER IN IMMEDIATELY (but they're not verified yet)
3075:                     session["user_id"] = new_user_id
3076:                     session["email"] = email
3077:                     
3078:                     cursor.close()
3079:             finally:
3080:                 put_db(conn)
3081: 
3082:             if not error:
3083:                 flash("✅ Account created! Please check your email to verify your address.", "success")
3084:                 return redirect(url_for("request_verification"))  # Redirect to verification page
3085: 
3086:     return render_template("register.html", error=error)
3087: 
3088: @app.route("/verify-email/<token>")
3089: def verify_email(token):
3090:     """Verify a user's email address."""
3091:     conn = get_db()
3092:     try:
3093:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3094:         cursor.execute(
3095:             "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE verification_token = %s AND verification_token_expiry > %s AND email_verified = FALSE",
3096:             (token, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
3097:         )
3098:         user = cursor.fetchone()
3099:         
3100:         if user:
3101:             user_id, email = user
3102:             cursor.execute(
3103:                 "UPDATE users SET email_verified = TRUE, verification_token = NULL, verification_token_expiry = NULL WHERE id = %s",
3104:                 (user_id,)
3105:             )
3106:             conn.commit()
3107:             
3108:             # ⭐ LOG THE USER IN AUTOMATICALLY
3109:             session["user_id"] = user_id
3110:             session["email"] = email
3111:             
3112:             # Send welcome email (optional - do this in background or don't block)
3113:             # send_welcome_email(email, user_id)
3114:             
3115:             flash("✅ Email verified successfully! Welcome to Fritt Tracker.", "success")
3116:             return redirect("/")
3117:         else:
3118:             cursor.execute(
3119:                 "SELECT id, email_verified FROM users WHERE verification_token = %s",

3142: @limiter.limit("3 per hour", error_message="Too many verification requests. Please wait an hour.")
3143: def request_verification():
3144:     """Request a verification email (for users who didn't receive it or it expired)."""
3145:     error = None
3146:     success = None
3147:     
3148:     # If user is logged in, pre-fill their email
3149:     email = ""

3151:         conn = get_db()

3153:             cursor = conn.cursor()
3154:             cursor.execute("SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = %s", (session["user_id"],))

3158:             cursor.close()
3159:         finally:
3160:             put_db(conn)
3161:

3163:         email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()

3173: 
3174:                 if not email_verified:
3175:                     if send_verification_email(email, user_id):
3176:                         success = "✅ A verification email has been sent. Please check your inbox."
3177:                     else:
3178:                         error = "Could not send verification email. Please try again later."
3179:                 else:
3180:                     error = "This email is already verified. Please log in."
3181:             else:
3182:                 error = "No unverified account found with that email address."
3183:     
3184:     return render_template("request_verification.html", error=error, success=success, email=email)

3354: @app.route("/delete-account", methods=["GET", "POST"])
3355: def delete_account():
3356:     """Delete user account."""
3357:     auth = require_verified()
3358:     if auth:
3359:         return auth
3360: 
3361:     error = None
3362: 
3363:     if request.method == "POST":
3364:         password = request.form["password"]
3365: 
3366:         conn = get_db()
3367:         try:
3368:             cursor = conn.cursor()
3369:             cursor.execute("SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = %s", (session["user_id"],))
3370:             current_hash = cursor.fetchone()[0]
3371: 
3372:             if not check_password_hash(current_hash, password):
3373:                 error = "Incorrect password"
3374:             else:
3375:                 user_id = session["user_id"]
3376:                 
3377:                 # FIRST: Cancel any active subscription at Flutterwave
3378:                 cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
3379:                 if not cancel_success:
3380:                     # Log but don't block - we still want to delete the account
3381:                     print(f"⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription for user {user_id} before deletion")
3382:                 
3383:                 # Delete user data
3384:                 cursor.execute("DELETE FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
3385:                 cursor.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
3386:                 conn.commit()
3387:                 cursor.close()
3388: 
3389:         finally:
3390:             put_db(conn)
3391: 
3392:         if not error:
3393:             session.clear()
3394:             flash("Your account has been deleted. We're sorry to see you go!", "info")
3395:             return redirect(url_for("home", deleted=True))

3525: @app.route("/bulk-delete", methods=["POST"])
3526: @limiter.limit(lambda: "3 per day" if session.get('user_id') and get_user_tier(session.get('user_id')) in ['free'] else "10 per day")
3527: def bulk_delete_documents():
3528:     """Delete multiple documents at once with safety confirmations."""
3529:     auth = require_verified()
3530:     if auth:
3531:         return auth
3532:     
3533:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3534:     
3535:     # Get subscription tier for limits
3536:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3537:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3538:     
3539:     # Get document IDs from form
3540:     doc_ids = request.form.getlist("document_ids")
3541:     
3542:     if not doc_ids:
3543:         flash("No documents selected for deletion.", "error")
3544:         return redirect("/")
3545:     
3546:     # Limit check based on tier
3547:     MAX_BULK_DELETE = {
3548:         'free': 5,
3549:         'pro': 50,
3550:         'vip': 999,  # Essentially unlimited
3551:         'business': 999
3552:     }
3553:     
3554:     max_allowed = MAX_BULK_DELETE.get(tier, 5)
3555:     if len(doc_ids) > max_allowed:
3556:         flash(f"⚠️ You can only delete {max_allowed} documents at a time on the {tier.capitalize()} plan. Upgrade to delete more at once.", "warning")
3557:         return redirect("/")
3558:     
3559:     # Verify all documents belong to the user
3560:     conn = get_db()
3561:     try:
3562:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3563:         
3564:         # Get the actual document titles for the confirmation message
3565:         placeholders = ','.join(['%s'] * len(doc_ids))
3566:         cursor.execute(
3567:             f"SELECT id, title FROM documents WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) AND user_id = %s",
3568:             doc_ids + [user_id]
3569:         )
3570:         docs_to_delete = cursor.fetchall()
3571:         
3572:         # Check if any IDs were invalid (belonged to someone else)
3573:         if len(docs_to_delete) != len(doc_ids):
3574:             flash("Some documents could not be found or don't belong to you.", "error")
3575:             return redirect("/")
3576:         
3577:         # Get titles for flash message
3578:         titles = [doc[1] for doc in docs_to_delete]
3579:         doc_ids_to_delete = [str(doc[0]) for doc in docs_to_delete]
3580:         
3581:         # Delete the documents
3582:         placeholders = ','.join(['%s'] * len(doc_ids_to_delete))
3583:         cursor.execute(
3584:             f"DELETE FROM documents WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) AND user_id = %s",
3585:             doc_ids_to_delete + [user_id]
3586:         )
3587:         deleted_count = cursor.rowcount
3588:         conn.commit()
3589:         
3590:         if deleted_count > 0:
3591:             # Log the bulk deletion
3592:             log_user_action(user_id, "bulk_delete_documents", {
3593:                 "count": deleted_count,
3594:                 "titles": titles[:5],  # Only store first 5 to avoid huge logs
3595:                 "total": len(titles),
3596:                 "tier": tier
3597:             })
3598:             
3599:             if deleted_count == 1:
3600:                 flash(f"✅ Document '{titles[0]}' deleted successfully.", "success")
3601:             else:
3602:                 flash(f"✅ {deleted_count} documents deleted successfully.", "success")
3603:         else:
3604:             flash("No documents were deleted.", "warning")
3605:             
3606:         cursor.close()
3607:         
3608:     except Exception as e:
3609:         conn.rollback()
3610:         print(f"❌ Bulk delete error: {e}")
3611:         flash("An error occurred while deleting documents. Please try again.", "error")
3612:     finally:
3613:         put_db(conn)
3614:     
3615:     return redirect("/")

3669: @app.route("/import-csv", methods=["GET", "POST"])
3670: @limiter.limit(lambda: "20 per day" if session.get('user_id') and get_user_tier(session['user_id']) == 'vip' else "5 per day")
3671: def import_csv():
3672:     """Import documents from CSV file."""
3673:     auth = require_verified()
3674:     if auth:
3675:         return auth
3676:     
3677:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3678:     
3679:     # Check if user is on a paid plan
3680:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3681:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3682:     
3683:     # Only Pro, VIP, and Business can import CSV
3684:     if tier not in ['pro', 'vip', 'business']:
3685:         flash("📥 CSV import is a Pro feature. Upgrade to import multiple documents at once!", "warning")
3686:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3687: 
3688:     error = None
3689: 
3690:     if request.method == "POST":
3691:         if 'csv_file' not in request.files:
3692:             error = "Please upload a CSV file."
3693:         else:
3694:             file = request.files['csv_file']
3695:             
3696:             if file.filename == '':
3697:                 error = "No file selected."
3698:             elif not file.filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
3699:                 error = "Please upload a CSV file (.csv)."
3700:             else:
3701:                 try:
3702:                     stream = io.StringIO(file.stream.read().decode("UTF-8"), newline=None)
3703:                     csv_input = csv.reader(stream)
3704:                     
3705:                     headers = [h.strip().lower().replace(' ', '_') for h in next(csv_input)]
3706:                     
3707:                     title_match = None
3708:                     expiry_match = None
3709:                     
3710:                     for i, h in enumerate(headers):
3711:                         if h in ['title', 'document', 'document_title', 'doc_title', 'name']:
3712:                             title_match = i
3713:                         if h in ['expiry_date', 'expiry', 'expiration', 'expiration_date']:
3714:                             expiry_match = i
3715:                     
3716:                     if title_match is None:
3717:                         error = f"CSV must have a 'title' column. Found: {', '.join(headers)}"
3718:                     elif expiry_match is None:
3719:                         error = f"CSV must have an 'expiry_date' column. Found: {', '.join(headers)}"
3720:                     else:
3721:                         conn = get_db()
3722:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
3723:                         added = 0
3724:                         failed = 0
3725:                         
3726:                         for row in csv_input:
3727:                             if not row or all(cell.strip() == '' for cell in row):
3728:                                 continue
3729:                             
3730:                             title = row[title_match].strip() if len(row) > title_match else ""
3731:                             expiry_date = row[expiry_match].strip() if len(row) > expiry_match else ""
3732:                             
3733:                             if not title or not expiry_date:
3734:                                 failed += 1
3735:                                 continue
3736:                             
3737:                             try:
3738:                                 datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
3739:                             except ValueError:
3740:                                 try:
3741:                                     parsed = datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%d/%m/%Y")
3742:                                     expiry_date = parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
3743:                                 except ValueError:
3744:                                     try:
3745:                                         parsed = datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%m/%d/%Y")
3746:                                         expiry_date = parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
3747:                                     except ValueError:
3748:                                         failed += 1
3749:                                         continue
3750:                             
3751:                             try:
3752:                                 cursor.execute(
3753:                                     "INSERT INTO documents (title, expiry_date, user_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)",
3754:                                     (title, expiry_date, session["user_id"])
3755:                                 )
3756:                                 added += 1
3757:                             except Exception:
3758:                                 failed += 1
3759:                         
3760:                         conn.commit()
3761:                         cursor.close()
3762:                         put_db(conn)
3763:                         
3764:                         if added > 0:
3765:                             flash(f"✅ Successfully imported {added} documents! {failed} failed.", "success")
3766:                         else:
3767:                             flash(f"⚠️ No documents imported. {failed} rows had errors.", "error")
3768:                             
3769:                         return redirect("/")
3770:                         
3771:                 except csv.Error as e:
3772:                     error = f"CSV error: {str(e)}"
3773:                 except Exception as e:
3774:                     error = f"Error reading file: {str(e)}"
3775: 
3776:     return render_template("import_csv.html", error=error)

3885: def cancel_flutterwave_subscription(flw_subscription_id):
3886:     """
3887:     Cancel a subscription at Flutterwave.
3888:     Returns True if successful, False otherwise.
3889:     """
3890:     if not flw_subscription_id:
3891:         print("⚠️ No Flutterwave subscription ID to cancel")
3892:         return True  # No subscription to cancel
3893:     
3894:     try:
3895:         response = requests.put(
3896:             f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/subscriptions/{flw_subscription_id}/cancel',
3897:             headers={
3898:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
3899:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
3900:             },
3901:             timeout=30
3902:         )
3903:         
3904:         if response.status_code == 200:
3905:             data = response.json()
3906:             if data.get('status') == 'success':
3907:                 print(f"✅ Flutterwave subscription {flw_subscription_id} cancelled")
3908:                 return True
3909:             else:
3910:                 print(f"❌ Flutterwave cancellation failed: {data.get('message', 'Unknown error')}")
3911:                 return False
3912:         else:
3913:             print(f"❌ HTTP error cancelling subscription: {response.status_code}")
3914:             return False
3915:     except Exception as e:
3916:         print(f"❌ Error cancelling Flutterwave subscription: {e}")
3917:         return False

3920: @app.route("/cancel-subscription", methods=["POST"])
3921: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many cancellation attempts. Please wait.")
3922: def cancel_subscription():
3923:     """Cancel user's subscription."""
3924:     auth = require_verified()
3925:     if auth:
3926:         return auth
3927:     
3928:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3929:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3930:     
3931:     if sub_status['tier'] == 'free':
3932:         flash("You're already on the Free plan.", "info")
3933:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
3934:     
3935:     # Get current expiry and Flutterwave subscription ID before cancelling
3936:     current_expiry = sub_status.get('expiry')
3937:     flw_subscription_id = sub_status.get('flw_subscription_id')
3938:     
3939:     conn = get_db()
3940:     try:
3941:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3942:         
3943:         # FIRST: Cancel at Flutterwave
3944:         if flw_subscription_id:
3945:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
3946:             if not cancel_success:
3947:                 flash("Could not cancel subscription at Flutterwave. Please contact support.", "error")
3948:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
3949:         
3950:         # SECOND: Update our database
3951:         if current_expiry and current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
3952:             # Keep access until expiry, just mark as cancelled
3953:             cursor.execute("""
3954:                 UPDATE users 
3955:                 SET subscription_status = 'cancelled',
3956:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
3957:                 WHERE id = %s
3958:             """, (user_id,))
3959:             conn.commit()
3960:             
3961:             days_left = (current_expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days
3962:             flash(f"✅ Your subscription has been cancelled. You'll have {sub_status['tier'].upper()} access until {current_expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} ({days_left} days remaining).", "success")
3963:         else:
3964:             # If no expiry or already expired, downgrade immediately
3965:             cursor.execute("""
3966:                 UPDATE users 
3967:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
3968:                     subscription_status = 'cancelled',
3969:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
3970:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
3971:                 WHERE id = %s
3972:             """, (user_id,))
3973:             conn.commit()
3974:             flash("✅ Your subscription has been cancelled. You're now on the Free plan.", "success")
3975:         
3976:         cursor.close()
3977:         
3978:     except Exception as e:
3979:         print(f"❌ Error cancelling subscription: {e}")
3980:         conn.rollback()
3981:         flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
3982:     finally:
3983:         put_db(conn)
3984:     
3985:     return redirect(url_for("home"))

3988: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many reactivation attempts. Please wait.")
3989: def reactivate_subscription():
3990:     """Reactivate a cancelled subscription."""
3991:     auth = require_verified()
3992:     if auth:
3993:         return auth
3994:     
3995:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3996:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3997:

3999:     status = sub_status['status']
4000:     current_expiry = sub_status.get('expiry')
4001:     documents_trimmed = sub_status.get('documents_trimmed', False)
4002:     
4003:     # CASE 1: Already active → Just inform user
4004:     if status == 'active':
4005:         flash("Your subscription is already active.", "info")
4006:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
4007:     
4008:     # CASE 2: On free plan (documents trimmed) → Can't reactivate

4010:         flash("Your subscription has expired. Please purchase a new subscription.", "warning")
4011:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4012:     
4013:     # CASE 3: Admin-upgraded with no expiry → Reactivate immediately!
4014:     if current_expiry is None:
4015:         conn = get_db()
4016:         try:
4017:             cursor = conn.cursor()
4018:             cursor.execute("""
4019:                 UPDATE users 
4020:                 SET subscription_status = 'active'
4021:                 WHERE id = %s
4022:             """, (user_id,))
4023:             conn.commit()
4024:             cursor.close()
4025:             flash(f"✅ Your {tier.upper()} subscription has been reactivated!", "success")
4026:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
4027:         except Exception as e:
4028:             print(f"❌ Error reactivating: {e}")
4029:             conn.rollback()
4030:             flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
4031:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
4032:     
4033:     # CASE 4: Has expiry and is still valid → Reactivate!
4034:     if current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
4035:         conn = get_db()
4036:         try:
4037:             cursor = conn.cursor()
4038:             cursor.execute("""
4039:                 UPDATE users 
4040:                 SET subscription_status = 'active'
4041:                 WHERE id = %s
4042:             """, (user_id,))
4043:             conn.commit()
4044:             cursor.close()
4045:             
4046:             days_left = (current_expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days
4047:             flash(f"✅ Your {tier.upper()} subscription has been reactivated! Access until {current_expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} ({days_left} days remaining).", "success")
4048:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
4049:         except Exception as e:
4050:             print(f"❌ Error reactivating: {e}")
4051:             conn.rollback()
4052:             flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
4053:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
4054:     
4055:     # CASE 5: Expired - Can't reactivate
4056:     flash("Your subscription has expired. Please purchase a new subscription.", "warning")
4057:     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))

4059: @app.route("/payment/initiate", methods=["POST"])
4060: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many payment initiations. Please wait before trying again.")
4061: def initiate_payment():
4062:     """Initialize Flutterwave payment."""
4063:     auth = require_verified()
4064:     if auth:
4065:         return auth
4066:     
4067:     plan_id = request.form.get("plan_id")
4068:     plan_type = request.form.get("plan_type")
4069:     
4070:     if not plan_id or not plan_type:
4071:         flash("Invalid payment request.", "error")
4072:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4073:     
4074:     region = get_user_region()
4075:     currency = get_currency_for_region(region)
4076:     pricing = get_pricing(region)
4077:     
4078:     amount_map = {
4079:         'pro_monthly': pricing['monthly_raw'],
4080:         'pro_yearly': pricing['yearly_raw'],
4081:         'vip_monthly': pricing['vip_monthly_raw'],
4082:         'vip_yearly': pricing['vip_yearly_raw'],
4083:     }
4084:     
4085:     amount = amount_map.get(plan_type, 0)
4086:     if amount <= 0:
4087:         flash("Invalid payment amount.", "error")
4088:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4089:     
4090:     try:
4091:         base_url = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "tracker.fritt.org")
4092:         redirect_url = f"https://{base_url}{url_for('payment_callback')}"
4093:         
4094:         tx_ref = f"fritt_{session['user_id']}_{int(time.time())}"
4095:         
4096:         payload = {
4097:             'amount': str(amount),
4098:             'currency': currency,
4099:             'tx_ref': tx_ref,
4100:             'payment_plan': int(plan_id),
4101:             'redirect_url': redirect_url,
4102:             'customer': {
4103:                 'email': session['email'],
4104:                 'name': session.get('email', 'Customer').split('@')[0],
4105:             },
4106:             'meta': {
4107:                 'user_id': session['user_id'],
4108:                 'plan_type': plan_type,
4109:                 'region': region
4110:             },
4111:             'payment_options': 'card,banktransfer,ussd,mobilemoney,qr',  # Still works with payment_plan
4112:         }
4113:         
4114:         print(f"🔍 Sending payment request: {payload}")
4115:         
4116:         # Use test or live endpoint
4117:         api_base = "https://api.flutterwave.com/v3"
4118:         if is_test_mode():
4119:             print("🔧 Running in TEST MODE")
4120:         else:
4121:             print("🚀 Running in LIVE MODE")
4122: 
4123:         response = requests.post(
4124:             f'{api_base}/payments',
4125:             headers={
4126:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
4127:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
4128:             },
4129:             json=payload,
4130:             timeout=30
4131:         )
4132:         
4133:         print(f"📨 Flutterwave response status: {response.status_code}")
4134:         print(f"📨 Flutterwave response: {response.text[:500]}...")
4135:         
4136:         if response.status_code == 200:
4137:             data = response.json()
4138:             if data.get('status') == 'success':
4139:                 session['tx_ref'] = tx_ref
4140:                 
4141:                 link = data['data'].get('link')
4142:                 if link:
4143:                     return redirect(link)
4144:                 else:
4145:                     flash("Payment link not found.", "error")
4146:                     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4147:             else:
4148:                 error_message = data.get('message', 'Unknown error')
4149:                 print(f"❌ Flutterwave error: {error_message}")
4150:                 flash(f"Payment initialization failed: {error_message}", "error")
4151:                 return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4152:         else:
4153:             print(f"❌ HTTP Error: {response.status_code}")
4154:             print(f"❌ Response: {response.text}")
4155:             flash("Payment initialization failed. Please try again.", "error")
4156:             return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4157:         
4158:     except Exception as e:
4159:         print(f"❌ Payment error: {e}")
4160:         import traceback
4161:         traceback.print_exc()
4162:         flash("Payment initialization failed. Please try again.", "error")
4163:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4164:

4166: @app.route("/payment/callback")
4167: @limiter.exempt
4168: def payment_callback():
4169:     """Handle payment callback from Flutterwave."""
4170:     auth = require_verified()
4171:     if auth:
4172:         return auth
4173:     
4174:     tx_ref = request.args.get('tx_ref')
4175:     transaction_id = request.args.get('transaction_id')
4176:     
4177:     if not tx_ref or not transaction_id:
4178:         flash("Invalid payment callback.", "error")
4179:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4180:     
4181:     try:
4182:         # Check if we're in test mode vs live mode
4183:         is_test_mode = os.environ.get("FLW_TEST_MODE", "false").lower() == "true"
4184:         
4185:         response = requests.get(
4186:             f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/transactions/{transaction_id}/verify',
4187:             headers={
4188:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
4189:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
4190:             },
4191:             timeout=30
4192:         )
4193:         
4194:         if response.status_code == 200:
4195:             data = response.json()
4196:             
4197:             if data.get('status') == 'success' and data['data']['status'] == 'successful':
4198:                 # Skip test mode transactions in production
4199:                 if data['data'].get('test_mode', False) and not is_test_mode:
4200:                     flash("Test payments are not allowed in production.", "error")
4201:                     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4202:                 
4203:                 user_id = session['user_id']
4204:                 
4205:                 meta = data['data'].get('meta', {})
4206:                 plan_type = meta.get('plan_type', '')
4207:                 
4208:                 if not plan_type:
4209:                     payment_plan = data['data'].get('payment_plan', {})
4210:                     plan_name = payment_plan.get('name', '')
4211:                     if 'Pro' in plan_name:
4212:                         plan_type = 'pro_monthly' if 'Monthly' in plan_name else 'pro_yearly'
4213:                     elif 'VIP' in plan_name:
4214:                         plan_type = 'vip_monthly' if 'Monthly' in plan_name else 'vip_yearly'
4215:                 
4216:                 tier = plan_type.split('_')[0] if plan_type else 'pro'
4217:                 
4218:                 # Get the Flutterwave subscription ID from the response
4219:                 # This comes from the payment_plan subscription
4220:                 flw_subscription_id = data['data'].get('subscription_id') or data['data'].get('payment_plan_id')
4221:                 
4222:                 # If we don't have a subscription_id, we need to fetch it
4223:                 if not flw_subscription_id:
4224:                     # Try to get subscription from the transaction
4225:                     transaction_data = data['data']
4226:                     if transaction_data.get('payment_plan'):
4227:                         # The subscription might be in the payment_plan object
4228:                         flw_subscription_id = transaction_data.get('payment_plan', {}).get('id')
4229:                 
4230:                 # Calculate expiry based on plan type
4231:                 # Flutterwave handles the recurring billing, but we track it in our DB too
4232:                 if '_yearly' in plan_type:
4233:                     expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=365)
4234:                 else:
4235:                     expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)
4236:                 
4237:                 conn = get_db()
4238:                 try:
4239:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
4240:                     cursor.execute("""
4241:                         UPDATE users 
4242:                         SET subscription_tier = %s,
4243:                             subscription_status = 'active',
4244:                             subscription_expiry = %s,
4245:                             flw_subscription_id = %s
4246:                         WHERE id = %s
4247:                     """, (tier, expiry, flw_subscription_id, user_id))
4248:                     conn.commit()
4249:                     cursor.close()
4250:                     print(f"✅ User {user_id} upgraded to {tier} (expires {expiry}, FLW ID: {flw_subscription_id})")
4251:                 finally:
4252:                     put_db(conn)
4253:                 
4254:                 flash("✅ Payment successful! Your subscription is now active.", "success")
4255:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
4256:             else:
4257:                 flash("Payment failed. Please try again.", "error")
4258:                 return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4259:         else:
4260:             flash("Error verifying payment. Please contact support.", "error")
4261:             return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4262:             
4263:     except Exception as e:
4264:         print(f"❌ Callback error: {e}")
4265:         import traceback
4266:         traceback.print_exc()
4267:         flash("Error verifying payment. Please contact support.", "error")
4268:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4269:

4284: @app.route("/webhook/flutterwave", methods=["POST"])
4285: @csrf.exempt
4286: @limiter.exempt
4287: def flutterwave_webhook():
4288:     """Handle Flutterwave webhook for subscription events."""
4289:     try:
4290:         data = request.json
4291:         if not data:
4292:             print("❌ No JSON data received")
4293:             return "No data", 400
4294:         
4295:         print(f"📨 Webhook received at {datetime.now(timezone.utc)}")
4296:         print(f"📨 Event: {data.get('event', 'unknown')}")
4297:         print(f"📨 Full data: {data}")
4298:         
4299:         signature = request.headers.get('verif-hash')
4300: 
4301:         # --- CRITICAL: Enable Signature Verification ---
4302:         if not verify_flutterwave_webhook(data, signature):
4303:             print("❌ Webhook signature verification failed.")
4304:             return "Invalid Signature", 401
4305:         # -------------------------------------------------
4306: 
4307:         if signature:
4308:             print(f"📨 Signature: {signature[:20]}...")
4309:         
4310:         try:
4311:             event = data.get('event')
4312:             
4313:             if event == 'charge.completed':
4314:                 print("✅ Payment completed webhook received")
4315:                 
4316:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4317: 
4318:                 # --- Reject test/mock transactions when not running in test mode ---
4319:                 if webhook_data.get('test_mode', False) and not is_test_mode():
4320:                     print("⚠️ Ignoring test-mode webhook transaction in production")
4321:                     return "OK", 200
4322:                 # -------------------------------------------------------------------
4323:                 
4324:                 user_id = None
4325:                 plan_type = None
4326:                 meta = webhook_data.get('meta', {})
4327:                 if meta:
4328:                     user_id = meta.get('user_id')
4329:                     plan_type = meta.get('plan_type', 'pro_monthly')
4330:                 
4331:                 if not user_id:
4332:                     customer = webhook_data.get('customer', {})
4333:                     email = customer.get('email')
4334:                     if email:
4335:                         print(f"📨 Looking up user by email: {email}")
4336:                         user = get_user_by_email(email)
4337:                         if user:
4338:                             user_id = user[0]
4339:                 
4340:                 if user_id:
4341:                     tier = plan_type.split('_')[0] if plan_type else 'pro'
4342:                     
4343:                     # Calculate expiry
4344:                     if '_yearly' in plan_type:
4345:                         expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=365)
4346:                     else:
4347:                         expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)
4348:                     
4349:                     # Get subscription ID from webhook
4350:                     flw_subscription_id = webhook_data.get('subscription_id') or webhook_data.get('payment_plan_id')
4351:                     
4352:                     conn = get_db()
4353:                     try:
4354:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4355:                         cursor.execute("""
4356:                             UPDATE users 
4357:                             SET subscription_tier = %s,
4358:                                 subscription_status = 'active',
4359:                                 subscription_expiry = %s,
4360:                                 flw_subscription_id = %s
4361:                             WHERE id = %s
4362:                         """, (tier, expiry, flw_subscription_id, user_id))
4363:                         conn.commit()
4364:                         cursor.close()
4365:                         print(f"✅ User {user_id} upgraded to {tier} via webhook (expires {expiry})")
4366:                     except Exception as db_error:
4367:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4368:                     finally:
4369:                         put_db(conn)
4370:                 else:
4371:                     print(f"⚠️ Could not find user for webhook: {data}")
4372:             
4373:             elif event == 'subscription.cancelled':
4374:                 print("❌ Subscription cancelled webhook received")
4375:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4376:                 
4377:                 # Find user by subscription ID
4378:                 subscription_id = webhook_data.get('id')
4379:                 if subscription_id:
4380:                     conn = get_db()
4381:                     try:
4382:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4383:                         cursor.execute("""
4384:                             UPDATE users 
4385:                             SET subscription_status = 'cancelled'
4386:                             WHERE flw_subscription_id = %s
4387:                         """, (subscription_id,))
4388:                         conn.commit()
4389:                         print(f"✅ User with FLW subscription {subscription_id} marked as cancelled")
4390:                     except Exception as db_error:
4391:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4392:                     finally:
4393:                         put_db(conn)
4394:             
4395:             elif event == 'subscription.expired':
4396:                 print("⏰ Subscription expired webhook received")
4397:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4398:                 
4399:                 # Find user by subscription ID and downgrade
4400:                 subscription_id = webhook_data.get('id')
4401:                 if subscription_id:
4402:                     conn = get_db()
4403:                     try:
4404:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4405:                         cursor.execute("""
4406:                             SELECT id FROM users WHERE flw_subscription_id = %s
4407:                         """, (subscription_id,))
4408:                         user_result = cursor.fetchone()
4409:                         
4410:                         if user_result:
4411:                             user_id = user_result[0]
4412:                             # Trim documents to free limit
4413:                             trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
4414:                             cursor.execute("""
4415:                                 UPDATE users 
4416:                                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
4417:                                     subscription_status = 'expired',
4418:                                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
4419:                                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
4420:                                 WHERE id = %s
4421:                             """, (user_id,))
4422:                             conn.commit()
4423:                             print(f"✅ User {user_id} downgraded to Free via webhook")
4424:                     except Exception as db_error:
4425:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4426:                     finally:
4427:                         put_db(conn)
4428:             
4429:             else:
4430:                 print(f"ℹ️ Unhandled webhook event: {event}")
4431:                 
4432:         except Exception as process_error:
4433:             print(f"❌ Error processing webhook: {process_error}")
4434:             import traceback
4435:             traceback.print_exc()
4436:         
4437:         return "OK", 200
4438:         
4439:     except Exception as e:
4440:         print(f"❌ Webhook error: {e}")
4441:         import traceback
4442:         traceback.print_exc()
4443:         return "OK", 200
