4445: @app.route("/cron/reminders")
4446: @limiter.exempt  # Cron jobs should NEVER be rate limited
4447: def run_reminders():
4448:     """Endpoint triggered by cron-job.org to send daily reminders."""
4449:     provided_token = request.args.get("token") or request.headers.get("X-Trigger-Token")
4450:     
4451:     if provided_token != TRIGGER_SECRET:
4452:         abort(401, "Unauthorized: Invalid token")
4453:     
4454:     try:
4455:         import reminders
4456:         reminders.check_and_send_reminders()
4457:         return "✅ Reminders sent successfully.", 200
4458:     except Exception as e:
4459:         return f"❌ Reminders failed: {str(e)}", 500

4465: @app.route("/newsletter/subscribe", methods=["POST"])
4466: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many subscription attempts. Please wait an hour.")
4467: def subscribe_newsletter():
4468:     """Subscribe to newsletter."""
4469:     email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
4470:     
4471:     if not email:
4472:         flash("Please enter your email address.", "error")
4473:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
4474:     
4475:     conn = get_db()
4476:     try:
4477:         cursor = conn.cursor()
4478:         cursor.execute(
4479:             "INSERT INTO newsletter_subscribers (email, subscribed_at) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING",
4480:             (email, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
4481:         )
4482:         conn.commit()
4483:         cursor.close()
4484:     finally:
4485:         put_db(conn)
4486:     
4487:     flash("✅ Thanks for subscribing! You'll hear from us soon.", "success")
4488:     return redirect(url_for("home"))

4491: @app.route("/admin/newsletter")
4492: def newsletter_admin():
4493:     """Admin page to view newsletter subscribers."""
4494:     auth = require_admin()
4495:     if auth:
4496:         return auth
4497:     
4498:     conn = get_db()
4499:     try:
4500:         cursor = conn.cursor()
4501:         cursor.execute("SELECT email, subscribed_at FROM newsletter_subscribers ORDER BY subscribed_at DESC")
4502:         subscribers = cursor.fetchall()
4503:         cursor.close()
4504:     finally:
4505:         put_db(conn)
4506:     
4507:     return render_template("admin/newsletter.html", subscribers=subscribers)

4516: def _base_url():
4517:     """Return the canonical base URL (with scheme)."""
4518:     base = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "tracker.fritt.org")
4519:     if not base.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
4520:         base = f"https://{base}"
4521:     return base.rstrip("/")

4619: @app.route("/sitemap.xml")
4620: @limiter.exempt
4621: def sitemap():
4622:     """Generate sitemap.xml for search engines."""
4623:     from flask import Response
4624: 
4625:     base = _base_url()
4626:     today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
4627: 
4628:     static_pages = [
4629:         ("/", "1.0", "weekly"),
4630:         ("/pricing", "0.9", "weekly"),
4631:         ("/business", "0.8", "monthly"),
4632:         ("/resources", "0.9", "weekly"),
4633:         ("/use-cases", "0.8", "weekly"),
4634:         ("/compare/spreadsheets-vs-fritt-tracker", "0.8", "monthly"),
4635:         ("/contact", "0.5", "monthly"),
4636:         ("/feedback", "0.4", "monthly"),
4637:         ("/terms", "0.2", "yearly"),
4638:         ("/privacy", "0.2", "yearly"),
4639:     ]
4640: 
4641:     xml = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>']
4642:     xml.append('<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">')
4643: 
4644:     for path, priority, freq in static_pages:
4645:         xml.append(
4646:             f"  <url>\n"
4647:             f"    <loc>{base}{path}</loc>\n"
4648:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4649:             f"    <changefreq>{freq}</changefreq>\n"
4650:             f"    <priority>{priority}</priority>\n"
4651:             f"  </url>"
4652:         )
4653: 
4654:     for a in RESOURCE_ARTICLES:
4655:         xml.append(
4656:             f"  <url>\n"
4657:             f"    <loc>{base}/resources/{a['slug']}</loc>\n"
4658:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4659:             f"    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n"
4660:             f"    <priority>0.7</priority>\n"
4661:             f"  </url>"
4662:         )
4663: 
4664:     for u in USE_CASES:
4665:         xml.append(
4666:             f"  <url>\n"
4667:             f"    <loc>{base}/use-cases/{u['slug']}</loc>\n"
4668:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4669:             f"    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n"
4670:             f"    <priority>0.7</priority>\n"
4671:             f"  </url>"
4672:         )
4673: 
4674:     xml.append("</urlset>")
4675:     return Response("\n".join(xml), mimetype="application/xml")
